user.title: Connect to Seerr
user.description: Works with Seerr, Jellyseerr and Overseerr. Find the API key in Seerr under Settings → General.

data_description.url: The address Home Assistant uses to reach Seerr, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5055
data_description.external_url: The address you open Seerr at from your phone, e.g. https://seerr.example.com. Used for the Open in Seerr links and user avatars. Leave blank to use the Seerr URL.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Seerr at that address.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://
error.unknown: Seerr returned an unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Seerr server is already set up.

init.title: Seerr Requests options
init.description:
**Instant updates (recommended):** in Seerr go to Settings → Notifications → Webhook, turn it on, set the Webhook URL to:

`{webhook_url}`

and tick the notification types you want (at least *Request Pending Approval*). Without this, Home Assistant only checks at the interval below.

data_description.notify_services: Each phone gets new requests with Approve and Decline buttons. Leave empty for no notifications.
